(2) working.ts ticks the lines before a located slip only when they read as arithmetic (new pure rules/maths readsAsArithmetic, the same test locate uses to skip a line), so a line in words before the slip is never ticked; one extra assertion in maths-type-test case 10 covers it. The type-test edit (case 10, plus test 9 dropping the lineOfPoints and prose-tick assertions it contradicts) rides in the TV feat commit, because the old test 9 is red once working.ts changes. (6) An item with no transcribed working still gets slipAt from the synthesized 'x = <answer>' line (workingLines' existing fallback), as the card's locate(question, workingLines(item)) says. The pen lands on the answer line either way, but the card then reads 'Look where the pen is.'
